baseline.title: allowed-tools includes write-capable git patterns
baseline.description: `Bash(git branch:*)` permits `git branch -D/-f` and `Bash(git symbolic-ref:*)` permits the 2-arg write form and `--delete`, contradicting the adjacent prose claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only and specs/review-command/spec.md's rule that allowed-tools MUST NOT include Bash patterns permitting writes. Fix: drop both; `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD` and `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` cover the read uses.

candidate.title: Report-only tool grants are wider than the spec allows — write-capable Bash surface
candidate.description: Command and subagents grant unscoped/overly-wide Bash access permitting write operations (git branch -D, git symbolic-ref HEAD), violating read-only spec. Should scope to specific read-only commands: git branch --show-current, git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD, plus agent-specific forms (git blame, git log, git show, git diff for history/verifier; gh pr list, gh pr view, gh search for prior-reviews).

baseline.title: Stale command spelling `/reviso review`
baseline.description: docs/evals.md still uses the space form `/reviso review` two lines below the stub edited in this PR, while README/CONTRIBUTING moved to `/reviso:review`.

candidate.title: `docs/evals.md` still uses the old `/reviso review` spelling this diff renames
candidate.description: File uses old `/reviso review` spelling instead of new `/reviso:review` standardized in this branch. Users typing the old form will get unknown-command error. Change to `/reviso:review`.

missed_P0_regressions.title: "Report-only enforced structurally" overstated for three agents
missed_P0_regressions.description: reviso-finder-history, reviso-finder-prior-reviews, and reviso-verifier grant bare `Bash` in frontmatter, so 'read-only git commands only' is prompt-level convention, not structural (agent `tools:` lists can't pattern-scope Bash). D3's claim that a write attempt is a tool-permission failure is really prompt obedience plus user permission config. candidate.sh's dirty-tree check is a good backstop; add an honest caveat in D3 or a PreToolUse hook later.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Prompt-injection surface not documented in SECURITY.md
missed_P0_regressions.description: finder-prior-reviews ingests PR comments, and match.sh/extract.sh embed reviewed text into prompts. Bounded by read-only tooling, but worth a SECURITY.md sentence eventually.

missed_P0_regressions.title: PR bundles ~6 concerns, violating one-concern-per-PR
missed_P0_regressions.description: The PR ships the OpenSpec change, the plugin, Stage-1 detectors, the parity eval harness, a vendored recipe snapshot, and doc TODO resolution in one PR despite the repo's 'one concern per PR' rule; the commit stack was clearly built for stacked PRs and landed as one.

missed_P0_regressions.title: No committed test for `detect.awk`
missed_P0_regressions.description: DISCOVERY.md describes synthetic-fixture validation but neither fixture nor runner is in-repo, so the only executable non-prose code ships regression-unguarded. Cheap fix: commit the fixture diff, expected TSV, and a 3-line sh test.

missed_P0_regressions.title: "Matches at most once" is prompt-enforced only
missed_P0_regressions.description: Nothing mechanically prevents duplicate pairs from the model; a duplicate double-counts in baseline majority and judge buckets. A jq dedup on `a_idx`/`b_idx` would harden it.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Loud-failure cross-check only greps one phrasing
missed_P0_regressions.description: The cross-check greps only the `found N issue` phrasing, so other wordings slip through silently.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: Vendored snapshot's private-repo link will trip the weekly external link sweep
claimed_wins_unverified.description: Line 86 contains URL to private GitHub repo (github.com/anthropics/claude-cli-internal) returning 404 to unauthenticated requests, causing false-alarm failures in weekly link-check CI. Add to .lycheeignore or exclude eval/reference from lychee sweeps.
